value.en: Magnified 100 times, a drop of liquid crystal was dispensed onto a glass plate and a cover slip placed on top. The liquid crystal spreads out into a uniform film under the weight of the cover slip. The image was captured using a microscope configured for crossed polarised light. The colours come about because liquid crystal is birefringent - it changes the polarisation state of the plane-polarised light passing through it. Now, the sort of labyrinthine pattern is caused by a phase transition. The liquid crystal sample is placed on a heat stage and at a particular temperature called the phase transition temperature, the liquid crystal changes from an opaque state to a transparent state, this is the transition front. The image width is about 2mm.
value.fr: Transition de phase d'un cristal liquide induite thermiquement, vue en microscopie en lumière polarisée croisée avec grossissement 100x. - A une température précise, le cristal liquide passe d'un état opaque à un état transparent, et le front de transition produit le motif que l'on voit. Le cristal liquide étant biréfringent (il modifie l'état de polarisation de la lumière polarisée qui le traverse), cela fait apparaître les couleurs.
value.zh-hant: ​顯微鏡下放大100倍，將一滴液晶滴在玻璃板上蓋上蓋玻片，觀察從透明態向雙折射態的熱致相變。
